statements.status_notes: This CVE affects LiteLLM Proxy's authenticated /key/generate flow. The Airflow compat image runs the Airflow entrypoint, not LiteLLM Proxy, and does not expose or invoke that proxy route. google-cloud-aiplatform[evaluation] requires litellm<1.97 on Python 3.13, while the first fixed LiteLLM version is 1.100.4. Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-7hp6-4w63-5g45
